Done. One bounded repair, both defects, source frozen.

## What I did

**A — CG-IMPL-013 (measured Origin handoff reset).** The generic same-system handoff was always committing; `CROSSING_DESTINATION_WORLD_ID` in `tidegardenRoute.ts` just never listed `ch13-return`, so one render later the resolver still answered the departure world, App's swap effect reclaimed it and the ship was re-seated on the hearth pad (+2 epochs per attempt). Restored the one entry. `resolveStoryBootWorldId` is untouched — a reload mid-crossing still restarts from the hearth, so arrival stays earned by flight. New `main/src/App.test.tsx` (10 tests) drives the **real** flight store through the real `commitSystemPlanetHandoff` and evaluates App's own seam expression: post-handoff stable, pre-handoff not early-origin, offline/mismatched uncommitted, the measured reclaim still un-commits, ch8/ch10/boot controls unchanged. Counterfactual: pre-repair bytes fail exactly the post-handoff assertion.

**B — CG-IMPL-012 (standby stall).** Reproduced on CPU *before* editing, on the actual identity (seed 3215739679, world -1,-1, planet 50, voxel 2): `(-42,51.05,9)` is **over water**, and so is the lattice-aligned `(-42,·,10)` — so the planner returned `requestedGoalWasWet`, substituted her own cell, `already-at-resolved-goal`, one waypoint. That is the freeze; the off-lattice theory is not the cause. The audit's `(-42,20/22)` measure **0.00** from LONG and **0.30/0.46** from her actual recorded 57-sample offer — rejected numerically, as root required. Authored `W` was checked, not presumed, and also fails (his occupied pose, 2.00 off the short survey). Replaced the arithmetic constant with a chapter-local **selection**: nearest candidate the live footing supports that clears, by segments, his current leg through the untested recorded samples, `E→H`, the common route and his body, by 2.6 units — and an honest hold when none qualifies. No signed pose/route, clearance, arrival radius, shared nav or agency change. 9 regressions run the **real** `createFooting` over the real generator (every earlier chapter test used a flat fixture that answers "supported" over water); 4 fail on pre-repair bytes.

**Checks:** `npm --prefix main run verify`, cwd repo root, **exit 0**, 351 files / **3158** tests (baseline 3139, +19, none removed/changed); log SHA recorded. Rehash: 95/98 unchanged, exactly the 3 commissioned game-source paths changed, zero drift; all counterfactuals restored byte-exact; no destructive git; no GPU.

**Two things for your attention:** `main/src/App.test.tsx` was listed as an allowed path but did not exist — I created it rather than expanding scope, and recorded that. And no GPU acceptance is claimed: the fresh headed ch13-return capture, the walked-standby capture, and the COMMON 18-unit browser proof remain independent gates.
